text:
```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]
        python-version: [3.10, 3.11, 3.12]

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        cache: 'pip'
        cache-dependency-path: |
          **/pyproject.toml
          **/uv.lock

    - name: Install uv
      uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v2
      with:
        version: "latest"

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        uv sync --all-extras --dev

    - name: Run linter
      run: |
        uv run ruff check

    - name: Run formatter check
      run: |
        uv run ruff format --check

    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        uv run pytest

    - name: Run tests with GPU support (Linux)
      if: runner.os == 'Linux'
      run: |
        uv run pytest -m gpu
      env:
        CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES: 0

    - name: Run tests with GPU support (macOS)
      if: runner.os == 'macOS'
      run: |
        uv run pytest -m gpu
```
